title: Critical probability of composed majority
statement: For every natural number $m$, the critical probability of the Boolean function obtained by splitting an input of length $2+(2m+1)$ into blocks of lengths $2$ and $2m+1$, taking majority on the second block and then majority of that output and the two entries in the first block, is $\frac12$.
